comments.title: Kingdom Business Website
comments.short: A modern responsive full-stack business website developed for Kingdom Business using the MERN stack.
comments.description: A full-stack corporate website developed during an internship at Kingdom Business. The website includes essential business pages such as Home, About Us, and Contact Us, along with a downloadable product catalogue and dark/light mode. The frontend uses Tailwind CSS and the application is built using the MERN stack.

company.name: Kingdom Business
company.description: Kingdom Business is a business organization based in Ethiopia that distributes consumer products and operates its business activities from Addis Ababa.

comments.title: Enterprise SOC & Network Security Monitoring Lab
comments.short: An enterprise-grade security operations lab integrating firewall routing, IDS/IPS inspection, SIEM log correlation, and automated incident triage.
comments.description: An enterprise security operations and network monitoring laboratory integrating pfSense firewall routing, Suricata IDS/IPS for threat inspection, Wazuh SIEM for log correlation and monitoring, and automated incident triage. The project also uses Shuffle SOAR, OpenSearch, Kali Linux, and Git.

company.description: A cybersecurity laboratory project designed to demonstrate enterprise security monitoring, network threat detection, SIEM operations, and security automation.
